_comment: Release cooldown data (docs/cooldown.md). cooldownExempt: standing exemptions. npm: names or globs, rendered into ~/.npmrc, the pnpm global config, ~/.yarnrc.yml and ~/.bunfig.toml (bun takes exact names only, so globs are skipped there). uv: the packages I maintain plus marimo, exempted per uv tool (converge uv-tools) and per repo, never in the user-level uv.toml (uv merges that into every project's uv.lock). cooldownAllow: exact npm-registry releases ("<pkg>@<version>", or "<pkg>@1.0.0 || 1.0.1") let through before they are a week old, only ones I asked for; rendered into pnpm minimumReleaseAgeExclude, yarn npmPreapprovedPackages, bun minimumReleaseAgeExcludes and ~/.config/npm-cooldown/allow.json (pi's npm). Later releases of the package and its dependencies still wait; an entry is inert once its release is a week old, so removing it is optional.
